dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides land use information for Westbank First Nation and supports planning and land management activities within the community.

Feature Layer
  • WFN Land Use tracks land use designations and associated planning categories across the service area. The layer includes a land use label and an official community plan code, making it useful for viewing, interpreting, and managing future land use patterns.
Use Cases
  • Community and land use planning
  • Future development review
  • Map display and reference for land use designations
  • Supporting planning and policy workflows
Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation lands in the Central Okanagan region of British Columbia.

Access and Licensing

The service is hosted by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and maintained by Westbank First Nations. It is shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License and related terms of use.
